description.value: This study investigated cortical thickness differences in amphetamine-dependent patients and healthy controls, including effects associated with heavy alcohol use.

spans.text: The objective of the present study was to ascertain if amphetamine related brain cortical thickness deficits would be observed in a comparatively large real-world patient sample.
